business_problem: Albertsons needed to deliver highly targeted grocery promotions in milliseconds for millions of shoppers while keeping precision data at scale and simplifying the systems behind its offers engine.
solution_summary: Albertsons uses MongoDB Atlas together with MongoDB Search on Atlas to power the promotions engine behind its ecommerce grocery experience. The retailer wanted to turn precise product and customer data into personalized offers quickly enough to help inflation-sensitive shoppers see relevant discounts while they were still browsing online. By consolidating the database, search engine, and sync mechanism into one managed platform, Albertsons removed a standalone search engine and an in-memory cache from the architecture. Search on Atlas now helps the company manage more than 50,000 unique products across more than 2,000 stores and deliver roughly half a million active promotions to millions of end users in real time, giving ecommerce shoppers immediate access to value while reducing operational complexity for the engineering team.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Stores the retailer's product, promotion, and shopper data on a managed platform for the promotions engine.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Search on Atlas
solution_components.role: Provides relevance-based search and matching so the promotions engine can surface real-time offers while customers shop online.

data_flow: Product and promotion data is stored in MongoDB Atlas, MongoDB Search on Atlas indexes the same data set, and the promotions engine returns relevant discount offers to ecommerce shoppers in real time while they browse Albertsons grocery sites.
business_outcome: Albertsons simplified its architecture, can deliver half a million promotions across thousands of stores in real time, and improved the customer value experience for millions of grocery shoppers.
metrics: Albertsons has more than 2,200 stores, 402 stations, 22 distribution centers, and 19 manufacturing plants.
The company has almost 300,000 employees across 34 states.
Albertsons serves 35 million customers per week and has almost 32 million rewards members.
The platform manages over 50,000 unique products in over 2,000 stores.
The promotions engine delivers half a million promotions at any given time to millions of end users.
architecture_clues: Search, storage, and synchronization are combined on one managed Atlas platform.
Albertsons eliminated both a standalone search engine and an in-memory cache.
The workload serves real-time ecommerce offers instead of batch promotions.
